poor_FCS.question: What is the food consumption status of this household?

borderline_FCS.question: What is the food consumption status of this household?

moderately_food_insecure.question: What is the food security status of this household?

severely_food_insecure.question: What is the food security status of this household?

open_defecation.question: Type of sanitation facility used
open_defecation.response: None of the above, open defecation

unable_to_access_care.question: Were households able to obtain health care?
unable_to_access_care.note: Denominator is households that reported a health problem (col 6), not all households

facility_over_60min.question: Travel time to nearest functional health facility

children_not_attending.question: Did child attend formal school >= 4 days/week in past 6 months? (ages 5-18)

solid_shelter.question: Type of shelter or dwelling
solid_shelter.note: Inverted: score uses (100 - value); solid/finished houses only, apartments excluded

tent.question: Type of shelter or dwelling
tent.note: Summed with makeshift + no_shelter; emergency and transitional shelter excluded

movement_restrictions.question: In the last 3 months, have any members of your household faced restrictions when trying to move?

missing_civil_docs.question: Are any household members missing their civil documentation (passport, birth certificate, national ID, etc.)?
missing_civil_docs.note: Derived: score uses (100 - col 24). Col 24 gives % with no missing docs; inverted to give % missing at least one document.

psychological_distress.question: Have any members of your household experienced any signs of psychological distress?

unaccompanied_children.question: Are there children under 18 now living in this household without both of their parents?

Ar Rahad.match_note: Two OCHA COD localities share this name: SD13030 (North Kordofan) and SD12084 (Gedaref). MSNA Demography sheet records 62.4% urban for this locality. SD13030 is a major city and railway hub - the second largest locality in North Kordofan (~26,000 population, 2012 census) - consistent with a 62.4% urban profile. SD12084 is the Rahad agricultural irrigation scheme area in Gedaref, expected to be predominantly rural (cf. Gedaref siblings: Al Butanah 0%, Al Fashaga 31%, Galabat Ash-Shargiah 30% urban). Provisional assignment to SD13030 pending confirmation from IOM Sudan DTM.
